flows:
Navigate to https://doc.rust-lang.org/book/ch01-02-hello-world.html then Use the locked 320 CSS pixel viewport and scroll vertically only.
Find the quoted passage directly using page search or vertical scrolling.
Once there, look at the start of the passage, report whether the text fits across the viewport, and stop.
Do not scroll through the rest of the page.
Stay on this public site.
Do not sign in, register, pay, send or submit anything, or interact with a CAPTCHA or access challenge.
Leave fixture settings unchanged.
Use visible controls only.
At 320 CSS pixels, read the passage beginning “> dir /B %= the /B option says to only show”.
Verify the complete passage fits within the visible width using vertical scrolling only.
Get whether the complete passage fits within the visible width and save it as {{passage_width_fit}}.
